The '''River Elid''' begins just east of the [[Shantay Pass]] and flows across the [[Kharidian Desert]]. There are three bridges across this river. The northernmost bridge is close to the Shantay Pass and leads into the [[Uzer Hunter area]], and then on into the [[Ruins of Uzer]]. The next bridge is south-west of [[Pollnivneach]]. The final bridge joins [[Sophanem]] to [[Menaphos]], but the bridge is blocked on the Menaphos side.

The section of the river south of Pollnivneach is home to the [[crocodile]]s, a possible [[Slayer]] [[Slayer task|assignment]] from [[Vannaka]].

==Trivia==
*The word Elid backwards is Dile, which may be a play on words for the Nile River, acknowledging the crocodiles that reside nearby.
